stories.title: Crew Unloads Dragon and Begins New Space Experiments
stories.summary: New science experiments are getting underway aboard the International Space Station after a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft delivered about 6,500 pounds of cargo on Sunday, May 17. The Expedition 74 crew spent Monday unloading the new supplies, kicking off new research, and gearing up for a spacewalk. The post Crew Unloads Dragon and Begins New Space Experiments appeared first on NASA Science.
